u: ceph-clsinfo can show name, version, and architecture information about a specific class object.

-n, --name
Shows the class name

-v, --version
Shows the class version

-a, --arch
Shows the class architecture
ceph-clsinfo is part of Ceph, a massively scalable, open-source, distributed storage system. Please refer to the Ceph documentation at https://docs.ceph.com for more information.
